status: DRAFT for supervisor + ArtDirector review; expect one revision round
rationale: Night railroad run: every chapter a signal aspect on the Line. Rails/track present in 29/30 chapters by census; signals peak at p3c5 (21); the strike IS the stop. Cannot house any non-railroad book.
title_swap_test: Put any other title on a green-signal plate over converging rails and it reads wrong — the identity is railroad-specific.
references: Cassandre, Etoile du Nord (1927), V&A O74368 — rails head-on, speed romanticism
Salter, Atlas Shrugged 1957 jacket, LBI Griffinger 5525297 — tunnel-mouth + converging rails + signal-disc primitives
Ferriss, The Metropolis of Tomorrow (1929) — massing-before-detail, lit edges
Geometric lathe / banknote engraving — unforgeable line-work (dollar plates B-detail inside A)
1930s Fortune covers — industrial modernism made lush
Rodchenko/Lissitzky constructivist books (MoMA Rowell) — 2-3 flat hues, type-as-structure
Fountainhead APPROVED identity — submission shape, F1-F10 conditions

themes.light_sepia: ground #F2EAD8, text #1D2126; Green #1E7A4E, Amber #9A5F14, Red #A8322A (each >=4.5:1 for kickers, engineer verifies)

contrast_law: Aspects carry graphics + large display (>=1.6rem Barlow Condensed 600+) + kickers (>=0.7rem Space Mono 700, +0.34em) ONLY; body and small text stay Headlight on Nightballast (~13:1). Validators meter every opener title treatment.

layout.cover: asymmetric grid: left column kicker/title/rule/author/tagline/actions; right column cover.svg in #cover-art (class plate). No text-over-art. Footer meta unchanged.
layout.chapter_opener: full-bleed signal plate band (class signal, height by scale.weight) in #chapter-art; then part kicker (mono, aspect color) / chapter head (Barlow Condensed 1.7rem 600 uppercase +0.08em) / data line (mono: CHAPTER VIII · words) / aspect rule left-weighted; then body. F4 law: first body line visible without scroll at 1440x1000 for standard openers.
layout.reading_body: calm Crimson Pro; drop cap in Barlow Condensed 600 muted aspect; chapter-end mark via book CSS (aspect diamond, SVG or explicit-font glyph — no tofu)

art.medium: flat night-lithograph SVG: solid ink slabs, 2-3 flat hues per plate + lamp color, converging-line perspective, headlight beams as flat wedges (never glow filters), signal lamps as flat discs with hard 2px halo ring; linework >= 2px at final size; all original authored SVG

cover.composition: night signal plate, right column; green lamp over converging rails; no text in art

plates.sprite_symbols: plate-p1c1 .. plate-p3c10 (30 symbols, shared lamp/beam defs)
plates.max_height: 13rem standard cap; 9rem standard / 12rem grand / 13rem monumental / 7rem compact per scale.weight
plates.wording: captions are board codes (SIG I-08 · words), never prose labels
